children: Mobix Labs reported Q4 2026 revenue is tracking near the high end of its $1.4–$1.8 million guidance and announced expansion into rare earths via SPD and Winner Water moves.
Mobix Labs says Q4 2026 revenue will be near the high end of $1.4–$1.8M guidance, >100% QoQ growth and materially higher gross margins.
Mobix agreed to acquire Special Project Delivery (SPD); SPD has a definitive agreement to acquire Winner Water Services.
Winner builds a $25M funded rare earth extraction demonstration plant in Alabama to recover scandium and mixed rare earth oxides from coal ash.
Winner has received $53M in DoE/DoD awards over 10 years; demonstration plant permitting is complete with operations anticipated by Q1 2028.
Strategy aims to create a National Security Matters platform to onshore critical minerals supply chains and access public and federal capital.

title: Mobix Labs outlines rare earths push; expects Q4 revenue near high end of $1.4–$1.8M guide
